svg.title: Cyclical hour encoding and Ridge model comparison
svg.desc: Three-panel generated chart. A circle places 23:00 beside 00:00. A bar chart reports chronological test mean absolute error for raw, one-hot, and sine-cosine hour representations. An hourly line chart shows that the sine-cosine Ridge model follows the smooth daily ventilation-power pattern more closely than the raw-hour model.
